placements.note: RATP message at the T6 terminus; Line L is SNCF, so T6 is right, and at a terminus every train leaves toward Châtillon, so the single platform is the right one even though the message says 'direction Viroflay'.
RATP message saying 'direction Est' at La Défense matches RER A (Metro 1 terminates there), though the 'couloir coupole' location leaves a little doubt about Metro 1.
'Direction Cergy / Poissy' names RER A's branches; Line L (to Cergy) is plausible, but Line J (to Mantes) is probably an extra line.
Tracks A/B toward Paris and Cergy fit RER A and Line L, which share that service; Line J is correctly left unmarked.
'Quai 1 Voie 2, direction Paris Nord' points to the Line K main-line platform; RER B, which terminates here, is likely an extra line.
'Quai B' is ambiguous (platform letter vs RER B); SNCF as operator suggests RER C, so one of the two marked lines is extra either way.
Tracks C/D toward Paris could be the RER A terminus tracks or Line J; the message gives no way to tell, so marking both may be a superset.
